objective: Separate native filesystem syscall time from pattern/hash/compare, space queries, UI/controller and USB costs; then distinguish allocation/driver/media hypotheses with controlled disposable-fixture work.
current_session_execution: Host saved-evidence analysis only. No console, network-to-console, disk, USB or ATA commands.
release_dependencies: Capacity owner completes and qualifies BF final receipt/global reread/controls/reserve/XMB and separately required persistence/game/extent gates. PERF001 neither collects nor operates them.
Refresh current authority and coordinate hardware ownership through the human; no cross-chat messaging is authorized.
Separate authorization for a concrete new native diagnostic implementation; exact source/import/package/fault/cancellation review precedes any later hardware release.

A fresh reviewed hardware protocol binds firmware, drive identity, selected retained files and hashes, exact budget, app version, nonce, output location and stop/error behavior. No consumed app or stager is reused.

timer_contract.clock: Use native timebase (mftb) and actual timebase frequency from syscall147 as in accepted BF source; verify monotonicity, nonzero frequency and wide conversion. Store raw ticks/frequency; report microseconds and nanoseconds where resolution supports them. No assumed CPU frequency or clock scaling.
timer_contract.calibration: Before and after each run take 10000 empty bracketing pairs and 10000 minimal event/histogram pairs in memory. Record min/median/p95/p99/max, quantization and scheduler outliers; no I/O inside calibration. Retain raw values; use aggregate median overhead correction only, flag intervals near resolution and never manufacture negative latency.

components.name: read_syscall
components.scope: Bracket every sys_fs_read only; record requested/returned bytes, rc, short read, file and 64-bit offset. Does not isolate NAND, crypto or cache misses.

components.name: write_syscall
components.scope: Deferred disposable-write stage only; bracket every sys_fs_write separately from preparation and guards, retaining short-write progress and first error.

components.name: seek_open_stat_eof_close
components.scope: Separate open, 64-bit seek, stat, EOF check and close; preserve every return code. Read-only first stage performs no writable open or explicit storage flush.

components.name: space_api
components.scope: Bracket each syscall840 invocation independently; BF performs one before and one after each 1MiB write. Record both raw outputs plus their validated units; do not presume it scans allocation bitmaps.

components.name: generation_sha_compare
components.scope: Bracket generation, SHA update and comparison separately; additionally run CPU-only in-memory same-byte pipelines. Identical compiler/options, public seed and independently known vectors.

components.name: sync_close
components.scope: Deferred write stage records fsync and close independently at existing required boundaries, including failure cleanup. An API success is not a proof of ATA FLUSH or durable media completion.

components.name: controller_stop_ui
components.scope: Bracket controller polling, app callback, STOP-file open/read/close and each render/flip separately; preserve cancellation frequency. Record frames/skipped redraws and visible responsiveness.

components.name: usb_publication
components.scope: Time journal open/write/fsync/close and final publication separately. Exclude these intervals from syscall-only throughput but include them in end-to-end totals. Never disable integrity publication merely to improve the result.

components.name: driver_crypto_allocation
components.scope: First application diagnostic cannot observe these separately inside a syscall. They are INCLUDED in syscall elapsed time, not the whole-loop residual; retain hidden kernel/storage subcomponents as unknown. A future internal observer requires separately authorized static proof, lock/ABI/cost review and a disposable fixture; no external RAM or raw probes.

timer_contract.accounting: Use disjoint exclusive component timers and independent total elapsed time; record nesting explicitly for inclusive call trees. Bytes divided by summed successful syscall time is syscall-active throughput; bytes divided by total elapsed is end-to-end throughput. Preserve errors and zero-byte operations. Report decimal MB/s=1000000B/s, MiB=1048576B, GiB=1073741824B and IOPS with latency in us/ms.
timer_contract.distributions: Per workload report calls, bytes, min, median, p90, p95, p99 and max, partial I/O, rc counts, stalled intervals and per-pair totals. Record histogram boundaries and nearest-rank percentile rule. Use exact bounded samples or sufficiently fine bins to resolve5%p95/10%p99 changes, report quantile bounds and mark comparisons inconclusive if bin widths exceed thresholds. For small call counts label p99/max descriptive; do not present thousands of correlated calls or rolling samples as independent replicate runs.
timer_contract.memory: At most8MiB extra working memory: two1MiB aligned data buffers, <=1MiB timing/histogram/event storage, bounded per-file metadata and margin. Graphics memory separately accounted; compare a fixed accepted UI mode for both arms. No unbounded per-call logs or new heap walker.
timer_contract.overhead_acceptance: Instrumentation must add <=2% elapsed time in matched CPU-only/control and4KiB read-loop timing-on/off runs, within the total read cap, or report and redesign its sampling. Target unexplained whole-minus-exclusive-scope residual<=2% of wall time; if larger, add explicit scopes or disclose incomplete coverage. Reject negative residual/overlap beyond calibrated uncertainty. The residual is unaccounted application/instrumentation work and is never relabeled as hidden kernel or SSD time.

first_native_proposal.scope: Fresh application with read-only opens of an explicit retained BF-file allowlist, plus in-memory CPU tests and bounded USB evidence writes. No firmware change, no HDD payload writes/deletes/rename/truncate, no ATA commands and no current BF source modification.
first_native_proposal.filesystem_side_effect_limit: Read-only opens do not prove zero underlying metadata/housekeeping writes (for example access time). Do not claim physical write isolation; record the limitation in protocol and results.
controls: One application reader/QD1; record actual underlying device queue remains unknown. No concurrent games, installs, downloads, copies or changed cache/power/link settings.

Bind exact full file paths, nonce, sizes, complete expected hashes and file indices from qualified BF receipts. Independently precompute selected-slice SHA/pattern values from the public BF seed/file index/64-bit offset and cross-check independent vectors; a whole-file hash does not validate a slice. A post-run hash check validates later retained bytes, not transient bytes returned in syscall-only armA; label that arm accordingly. Accept no wildcard file discovery, mutable saves or incomplete tails. Use approved read-only extent evidence when available; logical file index is not physical position.
Use64-bit seeks and checked arithmetic. Data buffers aligned to4096 bytes; start offsets and sequential lengths multiples of4096. Keep compiler, CPU/UI mode, timers, seed and working set constant.

Do not flush/drop cache or reboot to manufacture a cold run. Label first-pass cache state unknown and repeated reads warm/mixed. Alternating A/B on the same range can favor the second arm; balance AB/BA and disclose this limitation. Use matched disjoint slices where useful, record their extent shapes and never call these raw SSD tests.

Record elapsed time/bytes and existing available-space outputs at admission/end. Preserve the capacity workflow's128GiB+2GiB margin; no new allocation consumes it. Do not use an old disk number as identity.

workloads.description: Same public pattern generation, SHA, comparison and combined pipeline in memory; six paired256MiB-equivalent processing arms.
workloads.purpose: Estimate CPU ceilings, timer cost and diagnostic overhead without invoking storage.

workloads.description: Six matched A/B pairs of256MiB per arm from two qualified256MiB retained ranges: A read syscall only with checked size/offset/bytes; B same read plus full pattern/SHA/comparison. Balance three AB and three BA and swap range assignment; both preserve stop/UI schedule. Post-run exact hash-check read of each selected256MiB range.
workloads.purpose: Separate read syscall-active time from verified-read end-to-end CPU work.3GiB paired traffic plus512MiB verification=3.5GiB.

workloads.description: For each4KiB/64KiB/1MiB read buffer, three64MiB runs over matched approved ranges, order counterbalanced. Each arm validates known content after timing outside the syscall interval.
workloads.purpose: Test request/copy/alignment overhead without assuming larger buffers improve games.576MiB total; no changes to native queue settings.

workloads.description: Three repeats of64MiB each in one early, one middle and one late qualified retained file; same1MiB buffer/content validation. Bind extents if known, otherwise call them logical-range comparisons.
workloads.purpose: Check read behavior across retained corpus while preserving occupancy.576MiB total; cannot infer NAND placement from file order.

workloads.description: Three repeats of8192 deterministic uniformly selected4KiB reads within an approved256MiB span, QD1, plus three repeats of1024 reads at64KiB with a fixed locality trace. Seek+read recorded separately; compare known bytes.
workloads.purpose: 96MiB4KiB+192MiB64KiB=288MiB; expose small-read latency tails and locality. Game-like synthetic trace, not a measured game.

workloads.description: Up to16 preselected immutable BA game executables, total109089728B, three read/hash/stat/open/close passes. No games or saves are modified or launched by this diagnostic.
workloads.purpose: 312.1MiB approximate; open/metadata/small-file mix and known content controls. Executables do not represent all streaming assets.

first_native_proposal.budget_policy: All readback, EOF reads, instrumentation controls and retries count toward8GiB absolute cap; planned5.21GiB leaves explicit headroom. Before EACH read require requested_bytes<=remaining_budget, including EOF/control reads; stop without issuing it otherwise. No unbounded retry. Stop at the first byte/time/error/reserve/owner boundary and publish partial results. The20min limit is cooperative between syscalls, not a guaranteed return deadline.
first_native_proposal.stop_errors: Controller Circle and fresh nonce STOP protocol checked before open and at whichever boundary comes first:1MiB transferred,64 random operations or the UI service interval. On stop issue no further workload I/O, close handles, preserve first error plus close/publication errors, retain evidence and exit through accepted process-exit route. A blocked syscall has no hard cancellation guarantee. Unexpected repair/format/update prompt or mismatch: stop/record, no retry, repair, restart or forced power action.
first_native_proposal.evidence: Fresh nonce, reviewed app/package hashes, firmware/drive bindings from current authority, run order, range/extent/cache labels, tick frequency/calibration, per-component summaries/histograms, per-run bytes/durations/rcs, before/after hashes, cancellation/reserve/UI telemetry and final checksummed receipt. No unique console keys or raw RAM. USB output is exclusive-create and bounded; no historical collector/stager is replayed.
first_native_proposal.interpretation: A large A-vs-B difference supports a diagnostic CPU/software ceiling. Equal A/B does not identify media as the bottleneck. Kernel-inclusive latency does not separate allocator, crypto, queuing or NAND. Read-only first stage cannot attribute the historical write step by itself.

later_disposable_proposals.state: Not authorized; require new fixtures and protocols independently of populated Lexar and protected PNY/Crucial/source image.
later_disposable_proposals.per_run_bounds: Initially at most16GiB new exclusive payload in <=16 files, <=48GiB total write+two full verification reads,128GiB available+2GiB+next-write margin,8MiB working memory and20min cooperative limit; lower caps where native speed requires it. Every expansion/occupancy-preparation workload has its own explicit total write/endurance/time budget and review; do not silently create hundreds of GiB to reach a target.

comparisons.control: Matched independently prepared disposable states at predeclared available-space levels; bind allocation maps/fragmentation, cumulative host writes and elapsed/idle histories. Preparing different levels changes other factors, so use matched states/replicates and state residual confounding.

Measure fresh allocation latency and map resultant extents later read-only; compare comparable available space/drive histories. No raw LBA writes, live defragmentation or forced placement on populated Lexar.

Timed same-sized new-file batches on separately admitted fixtures, fixed CPU/UI/guard pipeline, track all host-written bytes including preparation/verification metadata. Without controller counters report host bytes, not NAND writes or write amplification.

Balanced immediate-vs-predeclared30min ordinary idle between matched batches, unchanged power policy and environment. Obtain temperature only through separately reviewed supported telemetry after static capability proof; no SMART poll or ATA experiment is released here. No idle recovery does not prove no GC.

Use exact fresh identity/firmware/capacity/geometry and independently qualified disposable fixtures, matched workload/available bytes/history. No recommendation to replace current drive based only on generic marketing.

Any overwrite/preallocation variant restricted to owned disposable files with separate explicit authorization; preserve pattern/SHA/size/EOF and two read passes. Preallocation can shift cost and change semantics rather than remove it.

Owned synthetic4KiB..1MiB save-like writes with required fsync+close, and64MiB..1GiB install-like create/write/hash/rename ordering on disposable files only; no real saves/licenses/trophies or lengthy LBP3 chores. Successful syscalls do not qualify power-loss durability.

later_disposable_proposals.repeat_method: At least6 matched paired trials per change/stratum, balanced AB/BA or randomized blocks; keep complete per-run results including failures. Repeat across2 independently prepared disposable fixture states before generalizing. If budgets permit fewer, label pilot exploratory; do not derive confidence intervals from overlapping BF windows.

decision_criteria.throughput: Proposal threshold: >=10% median paired end-to-end gain and gain above2x timing/instrumentation uncertainty; consistent direction in at least5/6 pairs. Report uncertainty/paired spread; no speedup claim from a single best run.
decision_criteria.game_install_save: Proposal threshold: >=5% median reduction in approved brief existing-game load/install elapsed time or save completion latency (including required sync/close), above measurement noise. Run short owner-approved tasks only in a separate phase; synthetic gains alone do not establish game gains.
decision_criteria.latency_tails: No >5% p95 or >10% p99 regression in the same workload/stratum, no new >1s stalls where baseline lacks them, and no doubled maximum without explaining a baseline outlier. Sparse p99 is descriptive; expand samples only within a new reviewed budget if needed.
decision_criteria.correctness: Zero new mismatches, aliasing, short-I/O mishandling, ignored sync/close/USB failures, reserve breaches, stuck cleanup or loss of cancellation/UI behavior. Preserve first error and cleanup evidence. Native ordinary-restart and recovery/durability qualification remains separate from performance acceptance.
decision_criteria.no_gain: If syscall time dominates with no safe measured improvement, keep current stack/configuration. If only integrity-diagnostic CPU time improves, label benefit diagnostic-only and do not infer game speedup.

TRIM_gate: No DSM/discard implementation or experiment in this plan. Before even a future disposable protocol, prove exact device support, end-to-end permitted command path, dead-extent ownership including pending soft updates/repair/recovery, nested encrypted-LBA mapping, post-discard plaintext read semantics, allocation serialization, durable free-before-discard ordering, error handling and recovery. No whole-drive/live-data discard, reserve/cache safety bypass or presumed zero plaintext from RZAT.
